description: Defines the 'AcknowledgementStore' object for managing acknowledgment flags tied to content IDs within the application. Provides methods to check and set acknowledgment status in-memory.

methods.name: isAcknowledged
methods.description: Checks if the given content ID has been acknowledged.

methods.name: setAcknowledged
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgment status for a given content ID.
